div.head: Northu 57.1
div.ab: ⁊ we willað, þæt ælc Rompæni beo gelæst be Petres mæssan to ðam bisceopstole.
And we willað, þæt ælc Rompæni beo gelæst be Petres mæssan to ðam bisceopstole.
Und wir wollen, dass jeder Rompfennig zu Petri Festtag entrichtet werde an den Bischofsstuhl.
And we will that every Rome-penny be paid by St Peter's day to the bishop's see.
And it is our will that every Rome-penny is to be paid to the bishop's see by St Peter's day.
And we ordain that all dues to Rome are to be paid to the episcopal see by Saint Peter’s Day.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
